data.name: Eimaanul
data.gender_notes: Eimaanul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eimaanul refers to one who has strong faith and belief in Allah. The name is derived from the Arabic word 'eeman', meaning faith, belief, and certainty. The name Eimaanul carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eimaanul usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Eimaanul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eimaanul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Eimaanul
in_english.meaning: Faith in Allah and his messengers
in_english.long_meaning: Faith in Allah and his messengers and his religion is the foundation of Islam, and it is based on trust in Allah and his messengers. It involves accepting the Islamic creed and obeying Allah's commands and refraining from forbidden acts. Faith in Allah is the acceptance of the unity and uniqueness of Allah. Faith in the angels is the acceptance of the existence and role of angels in the universe. Faith in the books is the acceptance of the divine origin and authority of the Quran and other holy books. Faith in the messengers is the acceptance of the prophethood and message of the prophets. Faith in the Day of Judgment is the acceptance of the accountability and reckoning of human actions on the Day of Judgment.
